description: For a security tokenized by more than one issuer, every token on it side by side (issuer, structure, KYC gates, custody, chain and each issuer's stated target/area), plus every Hyperliquid perpetual on it (fees, funding, leverage; no ownership). Also covers securities that exist on-chain only as a perpetual. Exact counts are in the response. targetArea describes the issuer's stated audience, not eligibility. Without `query` it lists every such security; sector and industry filters are available.

industry.description: Only securities in this industry, e.g. "bitcoin-miners", "semiconductors", "memory-storage".

offset.description: Number of matches to skip; the nextOffset of a previous answer continues from there (absent at the end).

query.description: Company name, underlying ticker or ISIN — e.g. "Apple", "AAPL", "US0378331005". Omit to list all.

sector.description: Only securities in this sector, e.g. "crypto" or "funds".

name: compare_tokenized_access

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to fetch the next page; absent when there is no more

title: Compare tokens on one security
